Name: Matching Slime Hutch - Redux
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
[font=Tahoma][size=4]This mod retextures the slime hutch to better harmonize with the aesthetic of the other farm buildings. The texture for this mod was originally created by SlushieSlowpoke but they seem to have abandoned Stardew modding. Their original retexture of the slime hutch has been meticulously reworked to fit the new size of slime hutches. While the external appearance has been altered, the functionality and internals of the slime hutch [font=Tahoma][size=4]remain unchanged[/size][/font].[/size][/font] Four different config options for Seasonal Edits and ten different Slime Colors on the sign and in the tanks are available. Please view the images for reference of these options available in Mod Config Menu. The mod also includes full painting masks for all config options, allowing you to change the color of the building, roof and trim individually; all while still being able to choose your desired slime color and seasonal edits!
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=4]
